additional_requirements.title: Ensure build workers are single-used
additional_requirements.text: Create a clean build worker for every pipeline that is being run, or use build platform-hosted runners, as they typically offer a clean instance for every run.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure build worker environments and commands are passed and not pulled
additional_requirements.text: For each build worker, pass its environment and commands to it instead of pulling it.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure the duties of each build worker are segregated
additional_requirements.text: For each build worker, limit its responsibility to one duty.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure build workers have minimal network connectivity
additional_requirements.text: Limit the network connectivity of build workers, environment, and any other components to the necessary minimum.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure run-time security is enforced for build workers
additional_requirements.text: Deploy and enforce a run-time security solution on build workers.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure build workers are automatically scanned for vulnerabilities
additional_requirements.text: For each build worker, automatically scan its environmental sources, such as docker image, for vulnerabilities.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure build workers' deployment configuration is stored in a version control platform
additional_requirements.text: Document and store every deployment configuration of build workers in a version control platform.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure resource consumption of build workers is monitored
additional_requirements.text: Set reources consumption monitoring for each build worker.
